summary: NIFTY on NSE_INDEX: an index packet at Quote, then with a Depth client too: an index has OHLC and the previous close, no volume, totals, book or OI.

notes: indexData's percentChange and yearly high and low are not read by either side.

deviations.reason: An index packet carries no trade quantity, average price or book totals; the web sends them as 0 (tick.get(..., 0)) instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376); the desktop's index frame leaves them out.
The HDFC Securities web adapter repeats ltp as last_price in every frame; the desktop's common carrier sends ltp only (a per-broker alias for lane wire).

An index packet carries no trade quantity, average price or book totals; the web sends them as 0 (tick.get(..., 0)) instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376); the desktop's index frame leaves them out.
data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts no mode in its data.

The HDFC Securities web adapter repeats close as prev_close in every mode, LTP included; the desktop's common carrier sends close only, and in Quote and Depth only (a per-broker alias for lane wire). In an LTP frame built from an LTP-type packet the web's value is a proto3 0.0 (a web defect, see ltp_mode).

The desktop sends an index's change under the canonical names of the recorded Zerodha transcript beside the HDFC Securities adapter's change and change_percent (feed::dialect); the web adapter sends only its own names.

The HDFC Securities web adapter sends the broker token as a string in every frame; the desktop's common carrier has no such field. Lead decision: carry it as a per-broker extra, or record it as a desktop decision.

An index packet carries no trade quantity, average price or book totals; the web sends them as 0 (tick.get(..., 0)) instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376); the desktop's index frame leaves them out.

An index packet carries no OI. Once a Depth client holds the index, the desktop's frames send OI 0 (the feed fills a zero and the bridge carries OI at Depth) instead of leaving it out as the web does: a desktop defect (absent OI not marked).
